data.notes: This is AU Bank's own LIT Credit Card landing page plus the bundled 'LIT product guide' PDF (the other attached PDFs are generic insurance T&Cs, an FX forward disclosure and an outward-remittance checklist, with no LIT card mechanics). LIT is a modular card: features (accelerated rewards, lounge, cashback, subscriptions, fuel waiver) are individually purchased for 90-day periods, so no benefit applies by default. Two important cautions: (1) headline claims such as 'Up To 10x Reward Points', 'Save up to 7x', 'Avail benefits up to Rs 24,000 per quarter' and 'Earn up to 10X reward points' are 'up to' marketing and were deliberately not extracted; (2) the web page and the product-guide PDF give CONFLICTING milestone-cashback thresholds — the page says 5% on minimum spends of Rs 10,000 and 2% on Rs 15,000, while the PDF says 5% capped at Rs 500 on minimum Rs 7,500 in 30 days and 2% capped at Rs 1,000 on minimum Rs 10,000 in 30 days. Both are recorded verbatim; a human must resolve. No base reward rate (points per Rs spent), point value, forex markup or points expiry is stated anywhere in the document, so the multipliers (5X/10X) cannot be converted into a rate. Feature prices (e.g. Rs 199/299 per 90 days for accelerated rewards, Rs 399 per lounge visit, Rs 49 for fuel waiver) are subscription fees, not annual fees, and are described in this note rather than mapped to fee fields.

Card-specific items found: joining/annual fee INR 1,499 each with fee-waiver spend explicitly 'Not Applicable' (i.e. no spend-based waiver; not reported as a number because it is not numeric), forex mark-up 3.40% rising to 3.50% effective 15-Jun-2026, fuel surcharge waiver capped at INR 100 per statement cycle and (effective 15-Jun-2026) valid only on fuel transactions of INR 500-3,000. Cautions for later readers: the 3-year reward-point expiry clause applies only to cards with YES CC Rewardz points as a feature, so it should NOT be attached to this cashback card; the domestic lounge spend-threshold table and the utility-spend reward-capping table do NOT list YES Prosperity Cashback Plus, so no lounge or utility reward cap can be inferred for it; the 1% DCC mark-up, 1% utility/fuel/rental/wallet transaction fees and interest rate of 3.99% p.m. ('Other Credit Cards') are portfolio-wide fees, not card-specific reward mechanics.

data.notes: This is YES BANK's family-wide 'Most Important Terms & Conditions' PDF (CMITC_V18_07082026) covering all YES BANK credit card variants, not a product page for this card. It does contain several rows that name 'YES Prosperity Rewards' specifically, from which fees, waiver spends, forex mark-up, utility reward capping and fuel surcharge waiver cap are extracted. Important caveats: (1) the document states NO base reward rate / points-per-spend for this or any card — reward earning is simply not published here; (2) the card carries the '**' footnote marker meaning 'Joining Fees is not applicable since cards are no longer sourced', i.e. it appears closed to new applicants, though the fee table still lists INR 399; (3) forex mark-up changes from 3.40% to 3.50% effective 15 June 2026 — both reported; (4) the fuel surcharge waiver percentage itself is written as 'up to 1%' so the percentage was deliberately not extracted, only the INR 100 per-statement cap and the INR 500–INR 3,000 eligible transaction range (range not a schema field); (5) many numbers in the document (finance charges 3.99% p.m., late payment, cash advance, rental/wallet/education/utility/fuel/toll/railway fees) are card-family-wide charges rather than this card's reward mechanics and are outside the schema fields.

This is YES BANK's portfolio-wide 'Most Important Terms & Conditions' PDF (version CMITC_V18_07082026) covering all YES BANK credit card variants, not a Zagg-specific page. Zagg appears by name in several variant tables, so a few card-level mechanics are extractable, but ALL of them come from multi-column tables rather than prose sentences — the 'source_quote' values for those rows are reconstructions of the table row (variant list + cell values) and should be re-verified against the PDF layout before use. Key cautions: (1) The document states NO reward rate, points-per-spend, point value, cashback rate or milestone benefit for Zagg anywhere; it is silent on Zagg's earn structure. (2) Zagg is NOT listed in the 'Reward Points Capping on Utility Spends' table, so it is unclear whether Zagg earns YES CC Rewardz at all — the 3-year reward expiry sentence is written for 'eligible YES BANK Credit Cards' generally, not for Zagg specifically, hence medium confidence. (3) Two different annual fees exist: current Zagg is in the NIL joining / NIL annual fee row, while footnote **** says Zagg cards issued before 10 Jan 2025 carry INR 399 + GST waived at INR 1,80,000 annual spends — do not merge these. (4) Fuel surcharge waiver percentage was deliberately NOT extracted: the only statement is 'YES BANK reverses up to 1% surcharge on eligible fuel transactions', an 'up to' ceiling. The named 1% waiver effective 1 June 2026 applies to POP-Club, not Zagg. (5) Zagg's fuel surcharge waiver transaction range is INR 400 to INR 5,000 effective 15 June 2026 (no schema field for a range, so not reported as an observation). (6) Many fees in this document (cash advance, auto-debit failure, cash/cheque deposit, re-issuance, overlimit, forex for some variants) carry future effective dates of 1 June 2026 / 15 June 2026.
